about.heading: We don't just write code;
about.intro: In a digital landscape cluttered with buzzwords, we provide clarity. Our team acts as your technical partner, translating complex business requirements into elegant, scalable software.
about.legacyText: Whether you're struggling with technical debt in a monolithic system or looking to secure reliable future-proofing system, we bridge the gap. We specialize in modernization strategies that minimize downtime and maximize value.
about.quote: Solvin transformed our 10-year-old platform into a modern cloud-native marvel in just 6 months.
about.innovationTitle: Innovation is a Process, Not a Spark
about.innovationText: We believe in rigorous engineering disciplines paired with creative problem solving. Our sprint-based agile methodology ensures transparency and rapid iteration, keeping you in the driver's seat.

web.title: Web Development
web.description: High-performance, scalable web applications built with modern frameworks.
web.details: We build PWAs, SPAs, and complex web portals using the latest React ecosystem. Our focus is on Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and SEO.

backend.title: Backend Systems
backend.description: Robust server-side architectures designed for reliability and speed.
backend.details: Microservices or Monolith? We help you decide and build API-first architectures that scale with your business.

mobile.title: Mobile Apps
mobile.details: One codebase, two platforms. We deliver smooth, mobile experiences for iOS and Android with offline-first capabilities.

odoo.title: Odoo ERP Solutions
odoo.description: Gold Partner standard implementation and customization.
odoo.details: Streamline your operations with Odoo. We specialize in custom module development, migration, and local accounting compliance.

cms.title: Headless CMS
cms.description: Decoupled content management for flexibility and performance.
cms.details: Content infrastructure that feeds your website, app, and watch. We implement structured content modeling for true omnichannel delivery.

seo.title: Technical SEO & Growth
seo.description: Data-driven strategies to dominate search rankings and drive organic traffic.
seo.details: We don't just guess; we engineer visibility. From technical audits and Core Web Vitals optimization to structured data implementation, we ensure your digital ecosystem is found by the right audience.
